## Checklist

- [ ] JavaScript only — no `.ts` / `.tsx` file, including config
- [ ] No new UI kit, router, CSS framework, state library or i18n library
- [ ] No client component imports the beCPG or session modules
- [ ] Everything I wrote is in English — identifiers, comments, log messages
- [ ] Every new environment variable is documented in `env.example`
- [ ] New statuses go through `StatusPill`; no status conveyed by colour alone
- [ ] Interactive elements are real `<button>` / `<a>` / `<input>` with a visible focus ring
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
